form.p: Creates an Eclipse E4 RCP example application (Eclipse 4.41, Java 21) that can be launched and exported as a native Eclipse product with Bndtools.
The project contains these run descriptors:
form.li: launch_base.bndrun - the OS independent part. Add your run requirements here and resolve only this file.
launch_win32.bndrun - run and export on Windows x86_64.
launch_linux.bndrun - run and export on Linux x86_64 (GTK).
launch_mac.bndrun - macOS fragments (product export for macOS is not supported yet).
form.p: Export the OS specific file as an executable JAR to get the product with the native launcher. Requires the geckoBndEclipse workspace library.
